note: Early brake of the fast race-cue pilot's looming governor inside the obstacle stack (visual_brain --obstacle-stack on|shadow with --early-brake on; off by default, also inside the stack; shadow computes and logs it in the shadow governor copy without applying it). haltere.liftoff.fast_race_cue.EarlyBrakeConfig, declared per motor contract, never per course or per brain: the brain contract (fast_velocity_brain_v1) has an entry; the fast PD contract has none and flies bit-identically with the flag on. Causal and course-agnostic: it reads the looming samples (TTC, reach, below fraction, lower-surface TTC), odometry, the measured velocity, the governor's own state and the pilot's checkpoint state; no course geometry, route, logged position or per-course value. Round 6 (branch m6-brake), after the round-4b/5 live hairpin failure minus-brain11cw13-r4b-noassist-01 (development case: the looming read a TTC of ~1 s from 1.3 s before the hairpin wall while the governor stayed armed until 0.8 s before it).
rule: A wall sample (not below-path terrain; with lower_window not explained by the lower window, i.e. its lower-surface TTC unknown or longer than its alarm TTC; with no_climb not during a governor terrain climb) votes for engagement when its remaining distance along its looming ray (capture-time reach minus the odometry travelled along the ray) is at most v*stop_latency_s + v^2/(2*stop_deceleration) + stop_margin_m at the measured closing speed v along the ray: the contract's measured stopping model (wall pilot turn_first_stopping). The governor's own confirmation count (confirm within confirm_window_s) engages a governor that is not braking yet, with its own graded target. The episode's targets are at least floor_speed while the floor holds; with floor_until wall_ahead it holds while the pilot sees its next checkpoint ahead (no turn-first checkpoint condition: side clamp, lost marker, bearing engage_deg or more off the heading, turn-first episode or side guard). Otherwise the governor brakes exactly as without the rule. The episode ends when the cap has released back to the closing speed at its engagement.

parameter_notes.stopping_model: stop_latency_s 0.3 s, stop_deceleration 3.5 m/s^2, stop_margin_m 0.5 m: the brain contract's measured model in configs/obstacles/wall_pilot.json (turn_first_stopping) and motor assist; at 4.5 m/s the brain needs 4.74 m (a TTC of 1.05 s), at 5.5 m/s 6.47 m (1.18 s), where the governor's own engagement waits for TTC < 0.8 s
parameter_notes.fast_pd: no entry: its model (0.15 s, 6 m/s^2) reaches the distance test about two samples (0.11 s) before the governor's own condition at 6 m/s; the governor's thresholds were chosen for it
parameter_notes.floor_speed: 2.5 m/s, motor assist v2/v3's approach floor: the brain stops from 2.5 m/s within 2.14 m, the room behind a gate arch before a wall (the Minus Two hairpin arch stands about 2.8 m before its wall), and it stays above the governor's stand-off speed (2 m/s), so an early episode never starts a stand-off with the ring ahead
parameter_notes.lower_window: true: the Straw Bale uphill rings loom at TTC 0.9-1.1 s at 4.5-4.8 m/s on the development laps (straw-brain11cw13-r4b-noassist-02, -r5-noassist-04) with a lower-surface TTC known and shorter than the alarm TTC; the Minus Two hairpin samples carry no vertical evidence (below_fraction None, no lower-surface TTC)
parameter_notes.no_climb: true: during a governor terrain climb the surface ahead is rising ground, the vertical guard's
parameter_notes.floor_until: wall_ahead: in the development harness (fast-brain-11-b-cw13, live-like wall samples) the floor until the governor's own engagement ('engagement') crawled at pass-through arches with the assist (lowest arch speed 0.17-1.6 m/s, pt41; 0.11-1.69, pt17) and hit more hairpin walls (h41 2, dev17 5, h67 1 of 12) than the floor while the ring is ahead (0.92-2.24 and 1.05-2.32 m/s; walls 1, 3, 0)

development.harness: motor_assist_eval hairpin sets dev17 (seed 17), h41 (seed 41), h67 (seed 67) and pass-through sets pt17, pt41, with live-like wall samples, fast-brain-11-b-cw13 (and brain-10b/09b on h41, pt41)
development.open_loop_hairpin: minus-brain11cw13-r4b-noassist-01: the cap binds the request from 22.42 s (1.18 s before the impact at 23.596 s; without the rule 22.83 s, 0.77 s), 3.18 m/s where the governor's own engagement later asks 3.47

not_included.ttc_lead: engaging at TTC < ttc_on + the contract's latency (0.8 + 0.3 = 1.1 s): the same samples at the hairpin, but independent of the speed; the stopping distance scales with it
not_included.standoff_exit: minus-fast6-r5-01's pillar (analysis in docs/early_brake.md): the stand-off cap along the hairpin wall's ray kept deflecting the fast PD's exit request by ~20 deg after turn-first had released aligned; a wall-pilot change, not this rule
